title: 隐藏 Windows Native Bridge 的原生文件对话框必须拥有可见 owner
summary: 隐藏运行的 Windows Native Bridge 如果直接显示无 owner 的 OpenFileDialog 或 SaveFileDialog，模态窗口可能出现在浏览器后方或不可见位置；当 Bridge 又以同步请求循环处理 IPC 时，ShowDialog() 会阻塞当前请求，前端表象会变成“选择文件没反应”或“第二次导出卡死”。Quick-Automatic-Hardsub-Encoder 先前已在 OpenFileDialog 上观察到同族问题；2026-10-03 的第二次硬压导出冻结进一步表明 SaveFileDialog 也需要同一 ownership 约束。当前实现统一使用位于鼠标所在显示器工作区内的短生命周期 TopMost owner，并通过 CI 守卫阻止导出路径重新创建无 owner 的保存对话框。
root_cause: 隐藏 PowerShell Bridge 没有可见主窗口。Export-Job 与 Export-Sample 直接创建 SaveFileDialog 并调用无 owner 的 ShowDialog()；后续模态窗口可能被 Windows 放到浏览器后方或不可见位置，而 Bridge 的单线程同步 HTTP 请求会一直阻塞在该调用上，因此用户看到的是导出冻结而不是一个可操作的保存窗口。
resolution: 将原生文件对话框 ownership 视为隐藏 Bridge 的统一生命周期约束，而不是只修单个 picker。
SaveFileDialog 与 OpenFileDialog 均使用位于当前鼠标显示器工作区内的短生命周期 1x1 TopMost Form 作为 owner，并在 ShowDialog(owner) 前 Show/Activate/BringToFront。
正式成品导出与测试片段导出统一走 owned SaveFileDialog helper，保留 RestoreDirectory、扩展名补全、覆盖确认和路径检查。
Windows CI 静态守卫要求 Export-Job / Export-Sample 不得重新实例化无 owner 的 SaveFileDialog。
regression_guard: Windows local smoke run 37068730392 completed successfully, including the repeated native export dialog ownership guard.
Existing native file picker visibility guard remains green, covering the same owner-placement family for OpenFileDialog.
remaining_risk: Hosted Windows CI can prove source/contract structure and bridge smoke behavior, but cannot prove that a real interactive SaveFileDialog is visibly foregrounded on every desktop/multi-monitor configuration. The merged fix still requires real-device repeat-export confirmation before this record should be treated as validated.

provenance.note: SaveFileDialog ownership fix and regression guard.
Includes parsing, dialog ownership guard, localhost bridge smoke, FFmpeg/libass and encoding checks.
Existing family for hidden Bridge native file-dialog visibility.
